_about: 2-Butanone (1) + Diethyl carbonate (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.325 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 2-butanone, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 2-butanone, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: A. B. Pereiro, A. Rodriguez, J. Canosa, J. Tojo, Vapor liquid equilibria for systems of diethyl carbonate and ketones and determination of group interaction parameters for the UNIFAC and ASOG methods, Fluid Phase Equilib. 235 (2005) 83-91
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 14, 16. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0036. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
